selection_basis: Local task measurements and explicit role; no universal best-model claim
scope: Historical batch/training branch. Current warehouse question runtime roles are published by clinical_core/agere/clinical/stack_runtime.py:Stack.model_roles and the /api/stack/meta endpoint; this file is not its active routing policy.

default_action_proposal.reason: Best measured family-held-out generator-target agreement in the current comparison, low runtime cost

clinical_encoder.head: artifacts/agere-full/action-specialists-v1/bioclinical-head.joblib
clinical_encoder.role: Trained alternative action proposal; latest note/document features

retrieval.role: Dense retrieval combined with BM25 and reciprocal-rank fusion

reranker.role: Relevance reranking on bounded candidates; not clinical entailment

decision_services.role: Interchangeable typed decision challenger; live access needs PERPLEXITY_API_KEY

frontier.role: Bounded difficult-case adjudication and structured policy proposals

joint_state.role: Care/channel/documentation hypotheses; earlier simulator training and explicit domain-shift limitation

tensor_train.role: Classical low-rank research comparator; not default

ocr.role: Native/scan text extraction with coordinates, zero hosted requests

not_default.Qwen: Earlier local reader underperformed; remains an experiment
not_default.MedGemma: No demonstrated advantage for current typed tabular/narrative tasks; no default download
not_default.Chandra OCR 2: Candidate for difficult-layout OCR; current native OCR is running and needs error benchmarking first
